sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.text: Frequently Asked Questions Straight answers from our factory team — MOQ, lead time, finishes and protection. Is LuxoPack eco-friendly packaging genuinely sustainable? Yes. The range is plastic-free, 100% recyclable, and FSC certified, made from paper sourced from responsibly managed forests and printed with soy-based inks for full recyclability. LuxoPack is also ISO 9001 certified. What plastic-free protective options replace foam inserts? LuxoPack uses molded pulp and honeycomb paper inserts to replace plastic foam, protecting products while keeping packaging fully recyclable. What is the minimum order quantity for eco-friendly mailers and bags? Mailers and paper bags start at an MOQ of 300 to 500 pieces, while rigid eco boxes start at 100 pieces. How long does production take for sustainable packaging? Bulk production takes 12 to 15 working days after sample approval, with physical pre-production samples ready in 3 to 5 days and rush structural samples in 24 to 48 hours. Do you supply eco-friendly luxury packaging for bulk and wholesale orders? Yes. Buyers describe this range as eco friendly luxury packaging, luxury eco friendly packaging, eco luxury packaging, or wholesale eco-packaging for online stores — all the same plastic-free, recyclable, FSC certified range described above. For bulk orders the quantities are the ones already given: mailers and paper bags from 300 to 500 pieces, rigid eco boxes from 100. Can online stores order eco-friendly mailers and boxes in bulk directly from the factory? Yes. Mailers and paper bags are produced from 300–500 pcs per size and rigid eco boxes from 100 pcs, made to order in Shenzhen and shipped to 50+ countries. Send the packaging type, inner dimensions, insert choice and quantity per size to get a bulk quote.
